## Public repository checklist

- [ ] Fixtures, stories, tests, docs and design packs use fictional names,
      handles and reserved domains (`.example`, `.test`, `example.com`) only.
- [ ] This title, body and the commit messages name no real organiser, venue
      or brand, handle, URL or name-derived id. Real organisers live only in
      the production database; describe one generically or by a case id.
- [ ] No bare `@name` except collaborators I mean to notify; code, handles and
      placeholders are in backticks.
